title.en: Lines of symmetry and alphabet cutouts

text.en: Prem and Manu want to paste HAPPY BIRTHDAY letters on the wall for Lali. They notice they do not need to cut each whole letter - folding the paper first is enough!

keepEnglishTerms: E N X T K V O

text.en:
A shape has a line of symmetry if folding along the line makes both halves match exactly. This is reflection symmetry.
The letter A has a vertical line of symmetry. To cut it: fold the paper in half, draw half of A along the fold, cut along the outline, and open it to see a full A.
The letter H has two lines of symmetry, one vertical and one horizontal. Fold the paper into four (one-fourth), draw one fourth of H, cut and open.
Now test the letters E N X T K V O. Horizontal line of symmetry: E, X, K, O. Vertical line: T, X, V, O. Both lines: X and O. N has no line of symmetry.
Letters with one line need a fold in half (half of the letter). Letters with two lines can be made from one-fourth of the letter.
Many designs can be made like this: a diya, a boat, a butterfly, a leaf. Fold, draw half, cut, open.
(additional, not in the textbook) A shape can have many lines of symmetry: a square has 4 and a circle has endlessly many.

problem.en: Which of the letters E, N, X, T have both a vertical and a horizontal line of symmetry?

text.en: Test each: E has only a horizontal line, T has only a vertical line, N has none.

why.en: Fold an imaginary letter both ways.

text.en: X is the same both ways, so X is the answer.

why.en: X looks the same after folding along both lines.

prompt.en: Explain how you would cut the letter H from paper using symmetry.

requiredIdeas.en: H has a vertical and a horizontal line
Draw one quarter of H on the folds, cut and open

points.en: Reflection symmetry means the two halves match after a fold.
A has a vertical line; H has two lines.
E, X, K, O have a horizontal line; T, X, V, O have a vertical line; X and O have both.
N has no line of symmetry.
